title: The front page
logline: Monday. The parody is up. By noon it is on the front page of Digg. The strip draws the front page as a wave coming over the seawall. The chorus is twelve now, then thirty.

panels.composition: The garage, morning. WOOD asleep face-down on the bristol. The CRT: the parody posted. BARNABY awake.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with saturated neon monitor glow cutting through a dark garage, jagged hyperactive linework, muddy digital flats, a man asleep face-down on a stack of bristol at a drafting table with a CRT monitor glowing beside him, a small dog awake

panels.composition: The monitor's screen drawn as the seawall, and over it, a wave: a front page, a number climbing — 400, 4,000, 40,000 — in the foam.
props: a wave with numbers in the foam

image.prompt: brush-pen line with saturated neon monitor glow cutting through a dark garage, jagged hyperactive linework, muddy digital flats, a CRT screen drawn as a seawall with a great wave breaking over it and numbers written in the foam, no words

panels.composition: Wood awake. The chorus at the back: twelve, then — the panel can't hold them — thirty, spilling past the border. The STICK HERO on the bristol, hovering six inches, smug.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with saturated neon monitor glow cutting through a dark garage, jagged hyperactive linework, muddy digital flats, a man staring at his monitor as thirty crude stick figures crowd past the panel's border behind him and a stick figure with a rotor hovers above a drawing on his desk

panels.composition: The marker clock on the wall: 0. Wood's hand, crossing out the last hour. Slowly. The dog's sigh.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with saturated neon monitor glow cutting through a dark garage, jagged hyperactive linework, muddy digital flats, close-up of a man's hand slowly crossing out the last number on a marker clock drawn on a wall, a small dog sighing below
image.notes: 72 hours done. The parody is out of his hands.

art.palette: limited; Sundays in watercolor, good now
art.paper: bristol; the browser; from 2008 coastal newsprint a week behind

notes: The front page as a wave. 'No.' The clock at zero.
